description.short: Drives a local Microsoft Edge profile through Playwright.
description.full: Connects Microsoft 365 agents to the local Playwright bridge so pages can be opened, read and operated in a dedicated Edge profile whose sign-ins the operator established once by hand. The session is stateful with a 30-minute idle timeout; nothing runs unless the tunnel is up and the bridge process is running on the operator's PC.

agentConnectors.description: Opens, reads and operates web pages in a dedicated local Edge profile through the Playwright MCP server. Stateful session, 30-minute idle timeout, reaches only what the signed-in profile can reach.
